title: Hurricane María, the debt and the response
goal: Explain what happened after Hurricane María and what people and institutions did, and for what purpose (*con el fin de*, *con miras a*).
grammar: purpose connectors, applied to Hurricane María, the debt and community response

items: I can say what an action is for with *con el fin de*, *con miras a* and *de modo que*.
I can say what happened in 2016, 2017 and 2019 and give the death toll as an attributed estimate.
I can use the new words for blackout, debt, board and spending cuts.
